subject: Soft serve machine displaying error code E-402 on POS terminal
description: The soft serve ice cream machine at our Thane West location is showing error code E-402 on the POS touchscreen terminal. The machine was operating normally this morning, but the error appeared around 6:30 PM today during peak service hours. The machine is currently non-functional and we are unable to dispense soft serve to customers. We have restarted the POS terminal once but the error code persists on the display.
